note: Each listing is checked against the business's own site or the Town of Lyons 'Visit Lyons' directory (lyonscolorado.com) and carries the date it was checked. Hours change seasonally; the linked site is the authority.

listings.name: Oskar Blues Grill & Brew
listings.blurb: The original Oskar Blues, open since 1997: Cajun-leaning kitchen, the beers that launched the craft-can movement, and live music most weeks.
listings.hours: Sun–Thu 11 am–9 pm, Fri–Sat 11 am–10 pm

listings.name: MainStage Brewing Company
listings.blurb: Brewery and pizza kitchen with a stage in the name for a reason: trivia, art openings and an open bluegrass pick on the weekly calendar.

listings.name: Spirit Hound Distillers
listings.blurb: Grain-to-glass distillery east of town making Colorado straight malt whisky, gin and rum, with a tasting room and a patio.
listings.hours: Sun–Tue 11 am–8 pm, Wed–Sat 11 am–9 pm

listings.name: The Rock Garden
listings.blurb: Riverside bar and food garden at the west edge of town: craft beer, local spirits, a Monday open mic and a lot of outdoor seating.
listings.hours: Mon & Wed–Thu 3–9 pm, Fri 3–10 pm, Sat–Sun 10 am–10 pm

listings.name: La Mariposa
listings.blurb: Classic Mexican kitchen at the east end of Main: molcajetes, margaritas and a patio.

listings.name: Smokin Dave's BBQ & Taphouse
listings.blurb: Slow-smoked barbecue and a long tap list, mid-block on Main.

listings.name: Indian Bites
listings.blurb: Fresh curries, biryani and saag, for eating in or taking to the park.
listings.hours: Mon, Tue & Thu 11 am–8 pm, Wed 4–8 pm, Fri–Sun 11 am–8:30 pm

listings.name: Mojo Taqueria
listings.blurb: Regional Mexican flavors, tacos and a busy bar; dinner most nights, lunch on weekends.

listings.name: Julie's Thai Kitchen
listings.blurb: Family-owned Thai kitchen at the east end of Main, dinner only.

listings.name: Marigold
listings.blurb: Northern Italian and southern French cooking in a small dining room; the town's dinner-out address.

listings.name: Lyons Locale
listings.blurb: Wine and cocktail lounge a block off Main with paninis, salads, soups and charcuterie boards.
listings.hours: Thu 4–9 pm, Fri 4–10 pm, Sat 2–10 pm, Sun 2–7 pm

listings.name: Lyons Dairy Bar
listings.blurb: Burgers, sandwiches and soft-serve at a walk-up window: the post-tubing stop.

listings.name: Moxie Mercantile
listings.blurb: Moxie Bread Co.'s Lyons outpost: coffee, pastries and loaves from the Louisville bakery.

listings.name: MudHut Lyons
listings.blurb: Drive-through coffee on the way into town from Longmont.

listings.name: Solace
listings.blurb: Gift and confectionery boutique on the 400 block: chocolate, candy and small presents.

listings.name: St. Vrain Market
listings.blurb: Deli, bakery and grocery: sandwiches and picnic supplies before the trail, staples after.

listings.name: Honorable Harvest
listings.blurb: Responsibly harvested herbs, teas and apothecary goods.

listings.name: Uniquely Lyons
listings.blurb: Lyons-branded gifts, shirts and souvenirs; part of every sale supports the town.
listings.hours: Mon–Fri 9 am–5 pm, Sat–Sun 10 am–4 pm

listings.name: Gatherings of a Lifetime
listings.blurb: Antiques and found treasures, open weekends.

listings.name: Western Stars Gallery & Studio
listings.blurb: Local art, jewelry, home décor and antiques in a working studio at the east end of Main.
listings.hours: Fri–Sat 10 am–5 pm, Sun 10 am–6 pm

listings.name: South Creek Ltd
listings.blurb: Handmade bamboo fly rods, built in Lyons for the St. Vrain and beyond.

listings.name: Lyons Classic Pinball
listings.blurb: A pinball hall with dozens of machines, monthly tournaments and a women's league.

listings.name: WeeCasa Tiny House Resort
listings.blurb: Twenty-plus tiny homes on the St. Vrain, a short walk from Main Street and next door to Planet Bluegrass.

listings.name: A-Lodge Lyons
listings.blurb: Adventure lodge on the river at the west edge of town, with the Rock Garden bar on site.

listings.name: Stone Mountain Lodge & Cabins
listings.address: North St. Vrain Dr (US 36), west of town
listings.blurb: Motel rooms and cabins on the road to Estes Park, with a seasonal pool.

listings.name: LaVern M. Johnson Park Campground
listings.address: LaVern M. Johnson Park, off Broadway
listings.blurb: Town-run riverside camping: RV sites with hookups year-round, tent sites mid-April to mid-October. Reservations through the Town.

listings.name: Planet Bluegrass
listings.blurb: The 20-acre riverside ranch that hosts RockyGrass and the Rocky Mountain Folks Festival, plus concerts through the year.

listings.name: Lyons Redstone Museum
listings.blurb: Local history in the 1881 sandstone schoolhouse, run by the Lyons Historical Society. Free; open in the summer season.

listings.name: Lyons Regional Library
listings.blurb: The library district's 2019 building: books, meeting rooms, programs most days and the Effie Banta Room for public meetings.
